notes: Tata CLiQ Luxury (luxury.tatacliq.com), Home department (LSH14) scoped per marketplace discipline. Tier-1 direct HTTP fetch used throughout (ClaudeBot explicitly allowed in robots.txt). Checked: (1) Homepage CMS nav config and full-page text scan: 0 hits for 'Clearance'/'Outlet'/'Final Sale'/'End of Line' anywhere, including the footer link list. (2) Prior-pass LSH14 taxonomy enumeration has no Clearance/Outlet L2 branch. (3) Every Home category PLP exposes a generic 'All Discount' filter facet (key=discountAll) with two checkbox values - 'Discounted Items' (count 14585 of the 24776-item department total) and 'Non - Discounted Items' (count 10583) - this is a catalogue-wide markdown filter applied to the SAME full listing, not a dedicated Clearance/Outlet page, and the site's own label is the generic word 'Discount', never 'Clearance' or 'Outlet'. Per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test this fails both prongs: no standalone listing exists, and the site's own taxonomy never names it Clearance-style. There is also an 'isDiscountedPrice' sort option labelled 'Discounts' that only re-orders the same full category listing (does not change totalResults), confirming it is not a separate merchandising concept either. (4) Guessed candidate slugs /clearance and /outlet both returned the generic SPA app-shell (no totalResults/product-grid JSON), not a real backend route. (5) Site search (q=clearance, scoped to category:LSH14) returned totalResults:0. No genuine Clearance-type merchandising PLP exists for this site's Home department; the only discount-adjacent signal found is a generic, catalogue-wide 'Discounted Items' filter checkbox, which was deliberately NOT recorded as a row because it is neither a standalone listing nor labelled Clearance/Outlet by the site itself.
